profile.name: Mikhail
profile.summary: Builds MCP-native tooling and AI infrastructure. Author of a production MCP server for codebase intelligence (LanceDB/BM25 hybrid search) in Zed.

projects.name: MSCodeBase Intelligence
projects.tagline: Intelligent codebase search & indexing for Zed
projects.description: Async MCP server featuring LanceDB/BM25 hybrid search, multi-bucket RAG, and autonomous self-healing workflows. High-performance, memory-safe, production-ready codebase intelligence.
highlights: Hybrid search (vector + BM25) with fused ranking
Memory-safe indexing pipeline (no leaks under load)

decisionLog.decision: LanceDB over plain SQLite FTS for embeddings
decisionLog.reason: Embedded vector store with zero-ops deployment; FTS5 tokenization breaks Russian stemming relevance.
decisionLog.tradeoff: LanceDB API surface changes between minor versions — pinned with rationale.

decisionLog.decision: Async MCP server (single process, async loop)
decisionLog.reason: MCP tool calls are I/O-bound; async keeps memory flat and avoids GIL contention for the index path.
decisionLog.tradeoff: CPU-bound reindex must be offloaded to a background task with progress events.

decisionLog.reason: Exact identifier matches beat fuzzy vector recall for code; fusion gives both.
decisionLog.tradeoff: Two indexes to keep consistent — resolved by a single write path.

projects.name: Gemma Agent
projects.tagline: Telegram assistant for a small trusted circle
projects.description: Telegram assistant with memory, routing, and tools when needed — built for a small trusted circle, not as a Google Gemma product.
highlights: Tool use gated by permission scope

decisionLog.decision: Memory as first-class state, not chat context stuffing
decisionLog.reason: Transcripts grow unbounded and dilute signal; extracted memory keeps token cost flat.
decisionLog.tradeoff: Memory summarization can drop context — mitigated by key-based retrieval.

projects.name: MSPortfolio (this site)
projects.tagline: The MCP-native portfolio you are reading right now
projects.description: A portfolio that is simultaneously a static dashboard, an MCP server about its owner's experience, and an interactive proof-of-work engine.
highlights: MCP server endpoint: any AI agent can query the CV
Browser agent-loop demo showing tool calls live
Live metrics with freshness + static fallback

decisionLog.decision: One repo: static site + MCP server, shared data files
decisionLog.reason: Single source of truth for projects.json; deploy MCP where a process can run (local / Worker / Space), site on GitHub Pages.
decisionLog.tradeoff: GitHub Pages cannot host the MCP process itself — documented in server/README.md.

decisionLog.decision: Browser-side agent demo instead of hosted LLM chat
decisionLog.reason: Static hosting has no backend and secrets; showing raw tool calls proves the work better than an opaque LLM answer.
decisionLog.tradeoff: No free-form dialogue — mitigated by intent-matched canned dialogues.
